name: Create Harmony Embeddings Scrna
description: Performs batch integration on single-cell RNA-seq data using Harmony and saves the integrated embeddings.
detailed_description: Performs batch integration on single-cell RNA-seq data using Harmony and saves the integrated embeddings.
when_to_use: When you need create harmony embeddings scRNA analysis

parameters.adata_filename: [Required] Filename of the AnnData object to load (str)
parameters.batch_key: [Required] Column name in adata.obs that defines the batch variable for integration (str)
parameters.data_dir: [Required] Directory path where the input file is located and output will be saved (str)

proven_params.params: Harmony2 on donor_id (19 donors), PCA 50 PCs, dims=1:30 UMAP, theta=2, max_iter=20, 6 iterations convergence
proven_params.result: 39,982 cells, 19 donors, 6 iterations, PC30=88.6% variance, UMAP clear separation by age/celltype

errors.message: RunHarmony with sample_id (16,003 unique) → 1 iteration convergence (pseudo-convergence). Harmony2 max.iter.harmony → max_iter, assay.use removed
errors.root_cause: sample_id had 16,003 unique values (individual cell barcodes), avg 2.5 cells/batch. Harmony requires sufficient cells per batch for covariance estimation. Harmony2 also changed parameter names.
errors.fix_applied: Switch batch variable from sample_id to donor_id (19 donors). Fix Harmony2 API: max.iter.harmony→max_iter, remove assay.use. 6 iterations, proper convergence.
